endpoint_users.getUsers.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all users in the system

endpoint_users.createUser.description: Create a new user account with the provided information

errors.description: User with this email already exists
errors.name: Conflict Error

curl.code:
curl -X POST https://prod.example.com/v1/users \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
  "name": "Alice Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword123",
  "role": "user"
}'

endpoint_users.getUser.description: Retrieve a specific user by ID

pathParameters.description: The ID of the user to retrieve

endpoint_users.replaceUser.description: Replace all user data with the provided information

pathParameters.description: The ID of the user to replace

curl.code:
curl -X PUT https://prod.example.com/v1/users/1 \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
  "name": "Bob Wilson",
  "email": "bob@example.com",
  "role": "admin",
  "status": "active"
}'

endpoint_users.deleteUser.description: Permanently delete a user from the system

pathParameters.description: The ID of the user to delete

endpoint_users.updateUser.description: Update specific fields of a user

pathParameters.description: The ID of the user to update

curl.code:
curl -X PATCH https://prod.example.com/v1/users/1 \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
  "name": "Updated Name",
  "status": "inactive"
}'

endpoint_users.checkUserExists.description: Check if a user exists without returning the user data

pathParameters.description: The ID of the user to check

properties.description: When the user was last updated
